messages.subject: Splitted QTL in model selection
parts:
Hi,


I'm using r/qtl to map fruit quality traits in a tomato RIL population with GBS based bin-map (3377 bins/markers).


I'm using a script (see attached) for a model selection (that is additive only).


I have encountered in 2 problems:

  1. Is it possible that a prominent QTL (LOD=5 in scanone) would be excluded from the final model? Can I add this QTL manually to the model?
  2.  In a certain trait the model have splitted a major QTL into two adjacent QTLs, and also create a mess in the markers (see attached file "ScanOne Vs Model"). In other traits having QTLs in the same chromosome there is no such a mess. Also, when I have discard the marker I have found “problematic”, the problem appeared in other QTL in different chromosome.

I would appreciate any help or idea you have.


Thanks


Itay
